items.title: 4 Bank Stocks That Deliver Retirees Dependable Passive Income
items.summary: One bank cut its payout to a dime, another raised it 18%, and a third has not budged in years. Retirees chasing quarterly income will want to see which big lenders earn their checks and where the hidden risks sit.

items.title: 5 Banks With Dependable Passive Income Dividends That Could Prosper as Rates Rise
items.summary: Every one of these five bank stocks slashed its dividend in the financial crisis, yet a new rate cycle may be rewarding patient holders. Only one has stopped raising its payout, and another carries a hidden capital risk worth knowing about.

items.title: M&T Bank Just Raised Its Dividend 20% as Earnings Support a Bigger Payout
items.summary: M&T's board just handed shareholders a much bigger check, and the earnings and capital numbers back it up. Still, shrinking margins and rising charge-offs hint at where the next test could come from, and rivals took very different paths.

items.title: Will KeyCorp's Investment in MMG Strengthen Its Real Estate Business?
items.summary: KEY's investment in MMG aims to integrate multifamily investment sales and financing. This will expand its commercial real estate reach and revenue opportunities.

items.title: Is CFO Succession Altering The Investment Case For PNC Financial Services Group (PNC)?
items.summary: PNC Financial Services Group has outlined a leadership shift, with retail banking head Alexander E. C. Overstrom set to take over as CFO on March 1, 2027. Long serving finance chief Robert Q. Reilly will move into an Executive Vice Chairman role focused on advising the CEO. The planned CFO handover comes as PNC Financial Services Group pursues heavy spending on technology, AI and a multiyear branch buildout. items.title: PNC Financial Gains 10% in the 6 Months: What's Ahead for Investors?
items.summary: PNC gains 10% in six months, supported by loan growth, branch expansion and acquisitions, but rising expenses and commercial credit risks remain concerns.
